title: Chizkiyah, Son of Rav’s Daughter

paragraphs: In [Sukkah 44b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.44b.5): Chizkiyah and Ivo, the sons of Rav’s daughter, brought a willow before Rav.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked text gives Ivo and Chizkiyah in that order and calls them the sons of Rav’s daughter.
Ivo and Chizkiyah bring the willow to Rav in the second episode of the paragraph. The first episode is Ivo’s report about a different willow brought to Rabbi Elazar bar Tzadok.
